panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 3 panels (A, B, C). A: Sagittal T1 MRI of a neonate with confirmed Zellweger syndrome showing frontal bossing (consistent with craniofacial dysmorphism) and mild ventriculomegaly, both characteristic manifestations of the disease. B: Axial T2 MRI of the same confirmed Zellweger syndrome neonate, with arrows pointing to bilateral perisylvian polymicrogyria (a neuronal migration abnormality), plus visible mild hypomyelination and ventriculomegaly, all classic disease findings. C: Coronal T2 MRI of the same confirmed Zellweger syndrome neonate, with arrows pointing to bilateral perisylvian polymicrogyria (a neuronal migration abnormality), plus visible mild hypomyelination and ventriculomegaly, all classic disease findings.

Additional radiographic findings (Figure 3) include stippled epiphyseal/chondral calcifications of the maturing skeleton, especially within the region of the knee (patella) and hip joints (triradiate acetabular cartilage) [7]. Zellweger syndrome is highly likely if elevated plasma very-long-chain fatty acids are noted in combination with imaging findings of bilateral peri-Sylvian pachy/polymicrogyria and chondrodysplasia punctate.

panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 2 panels (A, B). A: Cerebral ultrasound of a newborn in a Zellweger syndrome case report; caption states coronal posterior scan shows hyperechoic subcortical white matter. The finding is specific and captioned, but not present in the supplied vocabulary. B: Cerebral ultrasound in a newborn with Zellweger syndrome; caption identifies ventricular pseudocysts and linear hyperechoic striae in basal ganglia. Ventricular pseudocysts map to the germinolytic cyst finding.

in_text_mentions: ventricles with bilateral ventricular pseudocysts, hypoplasia of corpus callosum, poor insular gyration, hyperechoic subcortical white matter, and hyperechoic linear spots in the basal ganglia (Fig. 1). At 70 h of life clinical conditions worsened rapidly. The newborn presented with respiratory failure, low blood pressure, severe metabolic acidosis, low total white cell (2400/mm3) and neutrophil (480/mm3) counts; E. coli was yielded from blood
